died.name: Otho
died.cause: to a freedman, prior to committing suicide
died.last_words: Go and show yourself to the soldiers, lest they cut you to pieces for being accessory to my death.

died.name: Marie-Caroline of Bourbon-Two Sicilies, Duchess of Berry
died.last_words: Is not this dying with true courage and true greatness?

died.name: Kenneth Edward Gentry
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: Thank the Lord for the past 14 years that have allowed me to grow as a man. To J.D.'s family, I am sorry for the suffering you have gone through the past 14 years. I hope you can get some peace tonight. To my family, I am happy to be going home to Jesus. Sweet Jesus, here I come. Take me home. I am going your way.

born.name: Louis the Pious
born.cause: after turning his face to the wall before dying

born.name: Charles Lennox Richardson
born.cause: prior to death in the Namamugi Incident
born.last_words: I know how to deal with these people.

born.name: Anatole France
born.last_words: So this is what it is like to die – it takes a long time!

born.name: John Millington Synge
born.last_words: It is no use fighting death any more.

born.name: Vladimir Kappel
born.cause: dying during the Great Siberian Ice March
born.last_words: Let my soldiers know that I've always been committed to them, loved them and proved it by my death.

born.name: Charlie Chaplin
born.cause: to a priest who had said, "May the Lord have mercy on your soul"
born.last_words: Why not? After all, it belongs to him.

born.name: Selena Quintanilla-Pérez
born.cause: explaining her murderer's name and room number to the hotel staff shortly after being shot by Yolanda Saldívar
